description: ACT Government publishes this point inventory of municipal assets in the Australian Capital Territory. Subtypes include self-cleaning media filter systems and water filtration units. The provider describes attributes for asset subtype, number of filters, location and ownership. Assets are captured through works-as-executed handover or field audits. Coverage is limited to assets owned or managed by the named ACT government services; private, federal and other directorate assets may be absent. The Socrata catalogue and JSON view metadata are public and free to inspect. The native listing does not state a licence. Caveats: only metadata was inspected, no dataset rows or geometry values were downloaded. Field definitions do not establish field completeness or current asset condition. For infrastructure simulation, filter locations and equipment counts can represent treatment assets; treatment capacity and removal efficiency are not established. Related catalogue: ACT Government open data portal.
